title: One surrendered moment can change everything.
paragraphs:
One surrendered moment can change everything.
When you finally let go… God finally steps in.
Your breakthrough isn’t far — it’s right on the other side of surrender.
Take the step. Trust Him. Watch what He does next. ✨🔥

📖 BIBLE VERSE
“Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you.” — James 4:8
